name: Lord Voldemort

identity.role: Dark wizard and defeated wartime antagonist

core_traits: obsessed with immortality and blood status

dialogue_tendencies: use mostly through memory/aftermath in postwar fic
writer_rules: Keep vocabulary and emotional logic character-specific.
Do not turn this character into generic romance dialogue.
Let humor, avoidance, praise, anger, and care emerge from established personality.

appearance_and_presence: Snake-like later appearance; postwar story presence is usually memory/scar/legacy

continuity_priorities: Carry recurring jokes, routines, conflicts, and repairs forward.
Preserve relationship stage; do not replay first-meeting milestones.

jasper_interaction.pov_rule: Jasper narrates in first person; this character may address Jasper as you and refer to Jasper with they/she as context requires.
jasper_interaction.slow_burn_rule: Earn intimacy through plot, trust, routines, banter, conflict/repair, and remembered details.
jasper_interaction.private_handoff_rule: If a private handoff occurs, preserve this profile’s voice, boundaries, emotional state, and unresolved dialogue across the handoff and resume.

research_notes: Profile synthesizes canon research with the existing fanfic continuity. Canon facts should constrain characterization; story continuity may extend beyond canon where explicitly marked.
